one_liner: CivicState is a built civic-letter tool, but remains watchlist until paid demand and delivery trust are proven.

methods: Repo-file inspection for implemented product surface [evidence]

customer.definition: Individual constituent with a civic issue, desired outcome, and ZIP code [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts].
notCustomers: Claim filing or legal-demand users [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]
customer.validationGap: 0 evidenced paying customers in workspace inspection [evidence].

market.tam: $13,000,000 annual revenue from 1,000,000 purchases/year x $13.00 [assumption: unvalidated bottom-up demand proxy]
market.sam: $1,300,000 annual revenue from 100,000 purchases/year x $13.00 [assumption: reachable early audience proxy]
market.som: $15,600 annual revenue from 1,200 purchases/year x $13.00 [assumption: owner-operated validation case]
market.method: Bottom-up purchase volume x repo-derived price blend; no external market claims treated as evidence.

streams: $99/month organization/API starter concept [assumption: not active repo scope]
businessModel.marginFloor: 40.0% net margin floor in master plan [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]
businessModel.unitEconomics: Tests assert tier margins greater than 90.0% using $0.20/$0.40/$0.60 cost estimates [evidence: tests/payment.test.ts].

revenueAssumptions: Blended price is $13.00 [assumption: midpoint blend of $5/$15/$25 tiers].
2027 base paid campaigns are 1,200/year [assumption: owner-operated SOM].
2027 base revenue is $15,600 from 1,200 x $13.00 [assumption: reconciled model].
costAssumptions: Variable AI/delivery cost is $0.60/campaign [assumption: conservative use of highest test estimate].
Payment processing is 3.0% of revenue [assumption: generic card heuristic, no contract verified].
Cloud/tools are $300/month in validation [assumption: owner-operated stack estimate].
sensitivityTests: Conversion at 1.0% likely fails without distribution [assumption].
Bounce/complaint rates above 10.0% pause domains [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].
Blended price at $7.00 reduces 2027 base revenue to $8,400 [assumption: 1,200 x $7.00].

alternatives: Resistbot [assumption: named competitor from model knowledge]
Change.org [assumption: named competitor from model knowledge]
LegalZoom/document tools [assumption: adjacent substitute from model knowledge]

holes: No evidenced customer demand [evidence: workspace inspection].
Officials may classify automated letters as spam [assumption: delivery-channel risk].
Users may submit legal threats, harassment, or claim-like content [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md and moderation code].

strategy: Validate a narrow constituent-letter wedge before any broad civic platform claim.

goToMarket.firstCustomers: First 100 paying customers via concierge outreach, local civic newsletters, and low-risk municipal issue pages [assumption].
channels: Issue-specific SEO pages after compliance review [assumption]
goToMarket.doNotScaleBefore: 20 paid concierge campaigns and operator legal/compliance review [assumption].

operatorWorkflow.daily: Review flagged submissions, failed deliveries, payment discrepancies, and official opt-outs [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].
operatorWorkflow.weekly: Review paid funnel, refund requests, complaint rates, and human-review time [assumption].

constraints: Watchlist; personal/research asset until operator confirms business intent [evidence: wrk.dog registry note].
No legal advice, legal demands, claim filings, or harassment [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].
Workspace-only review; external market claims are assumptions [evidence: wrk.dog dispatch].
metrics: Paid campaigns per 100 submission starts [assumption: proposed metric].
Verified-citation coverage percentage [assumption: proposed metric based on researcher code].
Spam complaint percentage [assumption: proposed metric based on delivery risk].
Human-review minutes per campaign [assumption: proposed metric].

rules: Researcher may only cite supplied sources [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
Drafter may only use verified research and must include AI disclosure/disclaimer [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts].
Agent actions are logged with token counts and HMAC checksums [evidence: packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma].

unknowns: WrkPlug adoption [assumption: WrkPlug Phase 0 not yet signed].
